name: Jesse James
original_name: ジェシー・ジェイムス
source:
Billy's underling; a gunman who is learning the outlaw ways under Billy. Has a good head on her shoulders.

"I'm going to shoot you to DEATH!"

From Eiyuu Senki WWX.
